messages:
Maria: Quick design check — threshold stepper for SLO alerting. Mocked a stepper that moves +1% up to 5%, then +5% after. Empty state copy currently: "No thresholds yet — add one to get notified when burn starts." Thoughts on tone, keyboard flow, and a11y?
Jon: I like progressive increments. One concern: repeating +1% via keyboard is tedious. Can we support direct typing + long-press + modifier jumps?
Samir: Yes — numeric input + stepper combo works. Keyboard: Up/Down step 1, Shift+Up/Down step 5. Also allow type-in and accept Enter.
Aisha: Copy suggestion: "No thresholds yet — add a threshold to get notified when your SLO degrades." Also add a small "What is a threshold?" link to docs in the empty state.
Maria: Cool. Two copy variants I'm considering: A) "No thresholds yet — add one to get notified when your SLO crosses a threshold." B) "No alerting thresholds set — add one to be notified of SLO regressions." Which reads clearer?
Jon: A reads clearer to me for end users. B feels slightly more product-y/technical.
Samir: Accessibility bits: ensure stepper has aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow. For the preview panel, announce changes with aria-live="polite" so screen readers hear the updated sample alert.
Aisha: Preview should show a concrete example as the value changes: e.g. "When SLO < 99% for 10m, notify #pager". Use monospace for the rule snippet? It helps skimming.
Maria: Small UX nit: CTA wording — currently "Add threshold" vs "Create threshold". Other flows use "Create" (rule composer). We should be consistent.
Jon: We use "Create" elsewhere. Recommend "Create threshold" for parity.
Samir: Visual contrast note: stepper +/- icons are low contrast in dark mode. Need to meet WCAG AA for interactive controls and ensure focus ring is visible for keyboard.
Aisha: Mobile/touch: support long-press to accelerate increments. Also validation: do we accept decimals? Product docs say percentages should be integers. If so, show inline validation "Please enter a whole number percent".
Maria: Agreed — integers only. Placeholder idea: "Enter whole % (e.g., 99)". Error text role="alert" for invalid input.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: use descriptive aria-labels for buttons, e.g. aria-label="Increase threshold by 1 percent" and aria-label="Decrease threshold by 1 percent". Avoid relying on icons alone.
Maria: Great — plan: prototype update incoming with: numeric input + stepper, Shift modifier jump, placeholder copy "Enter whole % (e.g., 99)", CTA renamed "Create threshold", preview uses aria-live="polite" and shows sample rule. Posting updated Figma in ~10m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jon: :thumbsup:
